what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Venezuela in Italy: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 4525 Venezuelan asylum seekers in Italy, 0.4% of all asylum seekers from Venezuela.
Refugees from Venezuela, a separate group, live mostly in Spain, Brazil, the United States and Mexico.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Venezuela, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2024 and 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2012 at 8 asylum seekers.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Italy.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Italy only.
